messages:
maria: Hey team — can someone take a quick look at https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4856? It's a TF change to consolidate two GPU pools into a single pool and swap tags. Draft is ready for review, want to merge during the Tue maintenance window if no issues. :wave:
jen: pinged. I'll review in ~30m. anything I should focus on besides the tag rename?
sahil: main thing is to make sure we don't trigger instance replacements. If the plan shows `create_before_destroy` it's ok, otherwise we should stagger. :eyes:
max: heads up — this touches `module/vpc_subnets` indirectly, so eng-sre needs to sign off on routing implications. @eng-sre can you glance?
infra-approvals-bot: auto-check: terraform plan indicates 2 resources will be replaced (google_compute_instance.gpu-node). Suggested action: add lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } on sensitive instances or schedule rolling changes.
maria: thanks — I added a note in the PR about a canary rollout (will move two nodes first). Also added this short snippet in the PR to limit replacement:```terraform
resource "google_compute_instance" "gpu-node" {
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```
sahil: ok that helps. I'll focus on subnet and IAM bits. If you add an explicit canary plan in the PR description that's helpful for ops to approve faster.
jen: quick nit: tag key currently `env:prod-gpu` vs our standard `redwood:gpu_pool`, please align. small change, then LGTM from me after CI passes. :+1:
max: if eng-sre gives the green light I'll approve infra side. when's the merge window you were thinking?
maria: Tuesday 02:00 UTC maintenance window. If folks can approve by Monday EOD we can schedule the canary then.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window created for 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Reminder will post 24h before. :calendar:
